subject: Private offer packaging and channel split for PillarCloud
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@pillarcloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@pillarcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer: packaging & channel split for PillarCloud PO

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our RFP and a high-level usage forecast for the first 12 months. Two quick asks so we can move this internally:

1) Pricing banding: we want a private offer for a 12-month commitment (est. $1.1M list) with a blended discount. Can you confirm typical discount tiers for private offers at this volume and what you need to lock pricing?

2) Channel margin / pass-through: we’ll route through our reseller Atlas Partners. Atlas requires a 14% minimum reseller margin baked into the PO. We also want to reserve 2% for a performance uplift pool tied to usage growth. Can Redwood support a channel waterfall that preserves that margin while keeping your committed economics intact?

Also: PillarCloud prefers a single bundled SKU (compute + inference) rather than per-model SKUs — is that something Redwood can package as a single private-offer SKU so our procurement team can make a single-line purchase?

I attached the RFP and a short forecast. Can we get a preliminary model by end of next week? If helpful, happy to set a 30-minute call (prefer afternoons PT).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Cloud Procurement
PillarCloud

Attachments: PillarCloud_RFP.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@pillarcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer: packaging & channel split for PillarCloud PO

Hi Samir — appreciate the RFP and forecast. Looping in Ben (channel) and Laura (pricing ops) to help scope options. Quick answers up front and then a next step: 

- Bundled SKU: yes — we can create a single private-offer SKU that maps to a bundled product (compute + inference + support). We’ll surface a unitized metric (e.g., inference-hours) on the PO. 

- Discount tiers: for ~ $1.1M list over 12 months, our starting private-offer anchor is 18% off list for a committed 12-month contract. We can stretch to 20% with a 12-month upfront payment or a usage minimum guarantee. Laura — can you confirm if the upfront payment path changes revenue recognition notes?

- Channel margin / waterfall: we can support a reseller pass-through. Typical setup we propose: 14% guaranteed to Atlas (reseller margin), plus a 2% variable uplift pool that unlocks after month-6 if monthly usage > baseline. The total pass-through can be capped so Redwood keeps minimum net economics. Ben — can you help confirm Atlas' legal/PO billing preferences?

We’ve attached a draft pricing grid (redwood-pricing-grid-v2.xlsx) with two scenarios: (A) 18% list discount, monthly billing with usage smoothing; (B) 20% list discount with 12-month upfront. If PillarCloud wants the performance uplift pool to be paid through a separate rebate rather than built into the PO, we can do that as well (easier for accounting).

If that aligns, propose a 30 min call Fri afternoon PT to walk numbers and agree on the contract path.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid-v2.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: PillarCloud PO negotiation plan (notes)

Team — internal notes before call with Samir. Quick bullets, keep this tight for negotiation: 

- Anchor: offer Scenario A (18% list, monthly invoiced, 12m commit). Leave Scenario B (20% w/12m upfront) as the upsell. External ask is 14% reseller + 2% uplift pool; we can accept that but only if we: 
  * Confirm that Atlas issues PO to Redwood and clears reseller fee on invoice (no additional pass-through to Redwood).
  * Require PillarCloud to sign minimal usage floors (monthly baseline = 6.5% of 12m forecast) or we convert to Scenario B effective immediately. This mitigates revenue tail risk.

- Bundled SKU handling: create single-line SKU with underlying meter = inference-hours. We must prevent unbounded burst exposure — cap token rate/throughput in contract or add overage pricing (tiered).

- Uplift pool: prefer rebate path (post-period true-up) rather than building into list discount; easier for finance and avoids complicated invoice waterfalls. Laura: confirm rebate accounting mechanics — can be a P&L rebate rather than invoice credit?

- Legal: need Atlas reseller addendum and confirmation on tax/invoice flow. Ben — hold off on committing >16% non-recoverable distributor margin without legal sign-off. If they insist on >16% guarantee, require either (a) higher list discount to Redwood or (b) a co-signed revenue protection clause.

- Next steps: Grace will present numbers on Fri call. Ben to prep Atlas contact and reseller billing pattern. Laura to validate rebate vs invoice credit impacts and confirm revenue recognition.

Thanks,
Grace

On Thu, Jun 11, 2026 at 10:38 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samir — appreciate the RFP and forecast. Looping in Ben (channel) and Laura (pricing ops) to help scope options. Quick answers up front and then a next step: ...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@pillarcloud.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer: packaging & channel split for PillarCloud PO

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the call earlier. Quick recap and proposal so your procurement can move to PO: 

1) Pricing: Redwood proposes Scenario A as baseline: 18% off list, monthly billing, 12-month commit. We can offer Scenario B (20% off) in exchange for either (a) 12-month upfront payment or (b) a usage minimum guarantee equal to 95% of the forecasted first 6 months.

2) Channel + pass-through: we will honor a 14% guaranteed margin to Atlas Partners. The 2% uplift pool will be structured as a post-period rebate (quarterly true-up) payable to Atlas if usage triggers are met. This keeps the PO single-line while delivering on Atlas' commercial requirement. 

3) Bundled SKU: Redwood will issue a private-offer single SKU. The underlying meter will be inference-hours; overage beyond agreed monthly ceilings will bill at a published overage rate (we propose 30% over the effective unit price).

4) Legal / procurement items: Atlas needs a reseller addendum and confirmation that Atlas can invoice PillarCloud directly. We will provide a standard reseller addendum and a template PO appendix that clarifies the margin waterfall. 

Next steps: Grace will send the formal pricing grid and a short summary term sheet today. If PillarCloud agrees to Scenario A, we can push a private-offer link + Atlas addendum to you within 48 hours. Please confirm if PillarCloud prefers the uplift pool as invoice credit or as rebate — we recommend rebate for clarity.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
